name: Rehoboth Beach
question: Can dogs go on Rehoboth Beach?
answer: Yes, from September 16 through May 14. Dogs are banned from the beach and boardwalk May 15 through September 15. The city moved these dates in January 2026 — most guides still print the old May 1 to September 30 ban.
title: Can dogs go on Rehoboth Beach? The 2026 date change
metaDescription: Rehoboth moved its dog dates in January 2026: the beach and boardwalk now close May 15 – September 15, not May 1 – September 30. Sourced to the city.

rules.note: No dogs at any hour. There is no early-morning or evening exception during the closure.
The boardwalk closure runs on the same dates as the beach.

Leashed dogs are allowed, EXCEPT when lifeguards are on duty. Guards are typically still working the shoulder weeks in September and again in May — confirm the guard schedule before relying on this in mid-May or late September.
The lifeguard exception is written for the beach. Whether it also reaches the boardwalk is not settled in the published notice — treat as unconfirmed.

alsoTrue.label: Leash
alsoTrue.value: Required at all times a dog is permitted.

alsoTrue.label: Cleanup
alsoTrue.value: Required. Carry bags — off-season stations are not reliably stocked.

alsoTrue.label: Public dog park in town
alsoTrue.value: None. The nearest public off-leash parks are Millsboro and Milford, both about 40 minutes out.

correction.heading: Why the dates you found somewhere else are wrong
correction.body: Rehoboth ran its dog closure from May 1 to September 30 for years. On January 16, 2026 the commissioners re-cut the seasonal dates to match the city's parking season, moving the closure to May 15 – September 15. Rental agencies, tourism pages and blog posts are still publishing the old window. Practically, that means they will tell you dogs are banned for the second half of September when they are not, and that dogs are welcome in the first half of May when they are not. One of those errors costs you a trip; the other costs you a fine.

alternatives.name: Non-guarded and surf-fishing beaches in Delaware State Parks
alternatives.detail: Open to dogs year-round, including through the summer. Watch for discarded hooks and monofilament line — that is the tradeoff for a beach where dogs are legal in July.

alternatives.name: Slaughter Beach
alternatives.detail: Leashed dogs year-round, about 40 minutes north. Horseshoe crab sanctuary — in May and June the beach is carpeted with them and dogs will eat the molts.

alternatives.name: Assateague Island National Seashore
alternatives.detail: Dogs year-round on a 6-ft leash, outside lifeguarded areas. The National Seashore only — not Assateague State Park next door, which is where people get this wrong.

name: Dewey Beach
question: Can dogs go on Dewey Beach?
answer: Yes, year-round — Dewey is the only Delaware beach town that never closes to dogs. In summer they are limited to before 9:30am and after 5:30pm. You need a town dog license, and visitors get fined for skipping it.
title: Can dogs go on Dewey Beach? Hours and the town license
metaDescription: Dewey never closes to dogs — before 9:30am and after 5:30pm in summer, all day otherwise. A town dog license is required, visitors included.

rules.dateNote: The ordinance reads "the Saturday of Memorial Day weekend through the Sunday following Labor Day", so the dates move each year.
rules.note: Dogs are allowed, but only outside the middle of the day. This is the summer answer nobody publishes: every other town on this coast is shut, and Dewey is open at either end of the day.

All day, and off-leash is permitted if the dog is under your full control. Confirm what the town means by that before relying on it — "under control" is a judgement an officer makes, not a rule you can read.

licenseDetail: Every dog in Dewey Beach needs a town dog license, whether you live there or are visiting for a weekend. Three-day, eight-day and lifetime licenses are sold online and at Town Hall. This is the single most common way visitors get fined here — the beach hours are widely repeated, the license almost never is.

alsoTrue.label: License
alsoTrue.value: Required for visitors too. Three-day, eight-day or lifetime, online or at Town Hall.

alsoTrue.label: Off-leash
alsoTrue.value: Permitted off-season if the dog is under full control. Leashed in the summer window.

alsoTrue.label: Doodles in Dewey
alsoTrue.value: Late April, running 20+ years. Doodles are free to attend but still need the $5 town license.

correction.heading: Dewey is not closed to dogs in summer
correction.body: Aggregator pages tend to flatten the whole Delaware coast into one rule and tell you dogs are banned from the beaches all summer. That is wrong here. Dewey never closes — it narrows to early mornings and evenings between Memorial Day weekend and the Sunday after Labor Day, and runs all day the rest of the year. If you want a Delaware ocean beach with a dog in July, this is the closest one to Rehoboth by a wide margin. The catch is the license, not the hours.

name: Bethany Beach
question: Can dogs go on Bethany Beach?
answer: Not between May 15 and September 30 — dogs are off the beach and the boardwalk. They're allowed October 1 through May 14. Bethany reopens two weeks later than Rehoboth, which is the mistake people make driving down in late September.
title: Can dogs go on Bethany Beach? Beach and boardwalk dates
metaDescription: Bethany bans dogs from the beach and boardwalk May 15 – September 30, and allows them October 1 – May 14 — two weeks later than Rehoboth reopens.

rules.note: No dogs at any hour. There is no early-morning exception.
The boardwalk closes on the same dates as the beach.
Leashed, and cleaned up after. A town license and a worn tag are required.

licenseDetail: Bethany requires dogs to be licensed and to wear the tag at all times. Confirm whether this applies to visiting dogs or only to residents before relying on it.

alsoTrue.label: Leash
alsoTrue.value: Required and curbed at all times, everywhere in town.

alsoTrue.label: Running at large
alsoTrue.value: Dogs found loose may be handed to the Delaware SPCA.

correction.heading: Bethany and Rehoboth do not reopen on the same day
correction.body: Rehoboth moved its closure to May 15 – September 15 in January 2026. Bethany still runs to September 30. Fifteen miles apart, fifteen days apart, and almost every guide that covers both prints one set of dates for the whole coast. If you drive down in the second half of September expecting the same rule you read for Rehoboth, Bethany's beach is still shut to your dog.

name: Lewes
question: Can dogs go on Lewes Beach?
answer: Yes, but only before 8am and after 6:30pm from May 1 to September 30. All day otherwise, always leashed. Lewes was reviewing a full summer ban at guarded beaches in December 2025 — check before you go.
title: Can dogs go on Lewes Beach? Hours, and a rule under review
metaDescription: Lewes allows leashed dogs before 8am and after 6:30pm from May 1 – September 30, all day otherwise. A summer ban at guarded beaches was under review.

rules.note: Leashed, and only outside those hours. Lewes is bay-side, so this is the calm-water option for a dog that won't handle surf — but the window is narrow and the guarded stretch may be changing.
All day, leashed. Delaware's statewide leash law applies outside designated off-leash areas.

alsoTrue.label: Leash
alsoTrue.value: Required at all times. Statewide law outside designated off-leash areas.

alsoTrue.label: Water
alsoTrue.value: Bay, not ocean. Calm and shallow — the better choice for a nervous or senior dog.

alsoTrue.label: Off-leash in town
alsoTrue.value: Lewes Unleashed only. Private, roughly $60 a year per family, and a key fob is mailed to you before your first visit.

alsoTrue.label: Ferry
alsoTrue.value: Dogs ride the Cape May–Lewes Ferry free, on exterior decks. No paperwork.

correction.heading: This one may be about to change
correction.body: On 17 December 2025 a Lewes ad hoc committee met to consider banning dogs outright during summer at the guarded beaches, to reduce confusion and dog waste. The city's own FAQ still publishes the before-8am / after-6:30pm rule, and we have not found a record of a final vote. Given that Rehoboth quietly re-cut its own dates a month later, in January 2026, this is the single Delaware beach rule we would most want confirmed by phone before making a trip.

alternatives.detail: Minutes from Lewes, open to leashed dogs year-round outside the guarded swimming beaches. Entrance fee applies.

name: Fenwick Island
question: Can dogs go on Fenwick Island beach?
answer: No pets on the town beach at any hour from May 1 to September 30. They are allowed October 1 through April 30 — the strictest dates on the coast, and two weeks earlier than Rehoboth.
title: Can dogs go on Fenwick Island beach? Dates and limits
metaDescription: Fenwick bans pets from the town beach at any hour May 1 – September 30, and allows them October 1 – April 30 — the strictest dates on the coast.

rules.note: No pets of any kind, at any hour. The town beach runs from Lewes Street to E. Atlantic Street — outside that, you are in Fenwick Island State Park, where different rules apply.

alsoTrue.label: Where the town beach ends
alsoTrue.value: Lewes Street to E. Atlantic Street. Beyond it is Fenwick Island State Park.

alsoTrue.label: State park next door
alsoTrue.value: The park's surf-fishing and non-guarded stretches allow leashed dogs year-round. This is the closest legal summer beach to Fenwick.

alsoTrue.label: Scope
alsoTrue.value: The ban is written for all pets, not only dogs.

correction.heading: Fenwick is stricter than the towns above it
correction.body: Rehoboth closes 15 May and reopens 16 September. Bethany closes 15 May and reopens 1 October. Fenwick closes 1 May and reopens 1 October — two weeks earlier at the front and the latest at the back. Five towns on one twenty-five-mile stretch of coast, and no two of them share a set of dates. Any guide that gives you a single answer for "the Delaware beaches" is wrong about at least three of them.

alternatives.name: Fenwick Island State Park — surf-fishing and non-guarded beaches
alternatives.detail: Immediately north of the town beach. Leashed dogs year-round outside the guarded swimming area. Entrance fee in season.

alternatives.name: Assateague Island National Seashore
alternatives.detail: About an hour south. Dogs year-round on a 6-ft leash, outside lifeguarded areas. The National Seashore only — not Assateague State Park next door.
